# Module catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-module-catalog.py from ModuleRegistry - do not edit by hand. -->

## Other feature packages

Packages under `me.m0dii.modules` that are not ClickHUD modules (commands, editors, services).

| Package           | Purpose                                                                                                            |
|-------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `actionrunner`    | Action runner command set (`/actionrunner`).                                                                       |
| `automation`      | Rule-based automation engine: events, conditions, actions, templates, import/export (`/automation`).               |
| `camera`          | Camera paths: record a flight and replay it (`/camera`).                                                           |
| `clickgui`        | ClickHUD, the module browser (`N`), module registry and search.                                                    |
| `debugdraw`       | `/draw` shape and debug rendering.                                                                                 |
| `debugviews`      | Collision, heightmap, block-entity and fluid debug views (`/debugview`).                                           |
| `getdata`         | `/getdata` block and entity data inspection, Quick Edit, SNBT editor, server sync (op level 2).                    |
| `glow`            | Client-side entity glow outlines (`/glow`).                                                                        |
| `highlights`      | Shared block highlight rendering used by several overlays.                                                         |
| `hudcanvas`       | HUD canvas: persisted layout of HUD elements.                                                                      |
| `itemdata`        | `/itemdata` item component inspector and editor, server sync.                                                      |
| `macros`          | Macro manager, workbench editor, placeholders and provider extension points, macro HUD.                            |
| `mobdrops`        | Server-side mob drop trackers (`/mobdrops`) with client overlay.                                                   |
| `nbtcomplete`     | Command completion for SNBT, NBT paths and item components.                                                        |
| `optin`           | Server opt-in handshake for modules that need server consent (reach, xray, instant break, freecam, entity radar).  |
| `performance`     | Dynamic FPS limiter.                                                                                               |
| `quicktp`         | Quick teleport.                                                                                                    |
| `scripting`       | Groovy (`.groovy`), Kotlin (`.kts`) and JavaScript (`.js`) script execution, in-game script editor (`/runscript`). |
| `state`           | Remembers module on/off states and settings, plus profiles (`/m0profile`).                                         |
| `utilitycommands` | `/math`, `/scanblocks` and convenience commands such as `/craft`, `/anvil`, `/ec`, `/trash`.                       |
